title: Keep a useful step for next time
statement: As a developer, I can copy a step from a release into the template, so something we learned the hard way is there for every later release.
overview: Proposed addition. It closes the loop on an adapted checklist.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Promoting a step adds a copy to the template and changes the release's step only by marking it as from the template.
`release guide` lists a release's steps that are not in the template, without asking anyone to promote them.
